info.title: Peanut Admin HTTP API
info.description: Application HTTP contract for the identity, Tenant, article, file and notification entry points. Runtime authorization and Tenant binding remain enforced by the server middleware.

get.description: Delivers a ready Tenant-owned public or private file only while its Tenant is active. The application URL carries a short-lived single-use token, so links issued under the previous expires/signature contract are invalid. Every request rechecks Tenant state, responses are no-store, direct local or Provider object URLs are not part of the delivery contract, and existing file_key identities are unchanged.

get.description: Requires department update permission and an active department in the current tenant. Returns active tenant members whose accounts are active, ordered by member id; search is a literal display-name substring. Only the four declared query keys are accepted; page offset must fit PHP_INT_MAX.

tenantHost.description: 必须命中已登记的 Tenant Admin 入口；Host 不是身份凭证。

tenantRefreshCookie.description: Bearer 必须是发起刷新的精确 access token（允许过期或已轮换）。浏览器自动携带对应的 Secure HttpOnly refresh cookie，名称为本 client 的 __Host-pa_tenant_refresh_<client> 加下划线及 access token 的 SHA-256；hash 仅用于选择 cookie，服务端仍校验凭据属于同一会话。另要求可信 same-origin 浏览器请求；OpenAPI 固定 name 的 cookie scheme 无法表示该动态名称。

platformHost.name: Host
platformHost.description: 必须命中实例登记的 Platform Host；该约束不授予 Platform 权限。

platformRefreshCookie.description: Bearer 指定发起刷新的精确 access token。浏览器自动携带对应的 Secure HttpOnly refresh cookie，名称为 __Host-pa_platform_refresh 加下划线及 access token 的 SHA-256；hash 仅用于选择 cookie，不代替 Platform refresh 凭据校验。OpenAPI 固定 name 的 cookie scheme 无法表示该动态名称。

StorageSpaceCreate.description: The existing account selects the driver. local: local_path must equal public/storage or private/storage for access_type, bucket must be blank; persisted local region/endpoint must be null. Cloud: bucket required and local_path blank; qcloud also needs region, aliyun an http(s) endpoint, qiniu or any public cloud space an access_domain. Blank optional strings normalize to null. Account and location are immutable after creation.

access_domain.description: Blank normalizes to null; otherwise an absolute http(s) URL, with trailing slashes removed.

StorageSpaceUpdate.description: Revalidates the existing immutable account/location. qiniu or a public cloud space must retain a non-blank access_domain; omitted access_domain clears it and can therefore reject.

StorageRouteWrite.description: Target space must be active and have matching access_type. default.public/private must match their suffix; registered material/member/article/decoration/website purposes are public and export/attachment/document purposes are private. Upserts only this route.

variant_key.description: The actual selected derivative variant; null for original bytes.
